title: Bar exam review I: contracts, torts, real property and civil procedure
audience: a law graduate preparing for a U.S. bar exam (the Uniform Bar Exam or the NextGen bar exam)
purpose: Review the tested rules of contracts and sales, torts, real property and civil procedure, and practice exam-style multiple-choice questions and essays under time with an error log.
primary_reading: NCBE: exam information, content outlines and sample materials

weeks.1: The bar exam: the legacy UBE and the NextGen exam
weeks.2: Study planning and the error log

blocks.deliverable: Take a timed diagnostic set and build a study plan.
Write rule statements for 20 contracts issues.
Week 7 midterm; complete a timed mixed set.
Complete a timed 30-question civil procedure set.
Complete a timed mixed set and repair the three weakest topics.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Timed practice exam: complete a 50-question mixed multiple-choice set assembled from this course's questions and NCBE's free sample questions, and two supplied essay questions, under time; then write an error-log analysis and a two-week repair plan.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
